error_page.head: Sign-in error
error_page.title: We couldn’t sign you in
error_page.body: Go back to the application and try again. If it keeps happening, contact its support.
error_page.body_support: Go back to the application and try again. If it keeps happening, contact its support, or ours below.

reason.invalid_request: The application sent an incomplete or incorrect sign-in request. This is a problem with the application, not your account.
reason.unauthorized_client: This application is not allowed to sign users in right now.
reason.access_denied: You do not have access to this application.
reason.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
reason.unknown: The sign-in could not be completed.

error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
error.not_ready: The server cannot reach its database just now.
error.invalid_body: The request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
error.unsupported_body: The request was sent in a form this server does not accept.
error.body_too_large: The request is larger than this server accepts.
error.cross_site: Requests from other sites are not allowed.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.request_expired: This sign-in link has expired. Go back to the application and start again.
error.registration_closed: This application does not allow creating an account.
error.email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
error.reset_invalid: This reset link has expired or has already been used.
error.terms_required: Accept the terms and privacy policy to create an account.
error.details_required: Accounts here need details this page cannot ask for. Ask an administrator to create yours.
error.password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters.
error.password_breached: That password is known from a data breach, so it is among the first anybody would try. Choose another.
error.password_unchanged: The new password has to be different from the current one.
error.wrong_password: Your current password is not right.
error.current_session: This is the session you are using. Sign out instead.
error.not_yours: That session or application is no longer there.
error.social_unknown: That sign-in provider is not available.
error.social_expired: This sign-in took too long or has already been used. Start again.
error.social_upstream: The provider could not complete this sign-in. Try again.
error.social_no_email: The provider did not share an email address, so there is no account to sign in to.
error.social_link_refused: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with your password, then connect this provider from your account.
error.social_email_unverified: The provider has not confirmed this email address is yours, so no account was made with it. Confirm the address with the provider, or register with a password.
error.social_registration_closed: This provider cannot create new accounts here.
error.social_sso_required: Your organisation signs you in through single sign-on. Go back to the sign-in page and use it.
error.sso_unknown: That single sign-on connection is not available.
error.sso_expired: This sign-in took too long or has already been used. Start again.
error.sso_upstream: Your organisation's identity provider could not complete this sign-in. Try again, or contact your IT team.
error.sso_no_email: Your identity provider did not share a verified email address, so there is no account to sign in to.
error.sso_domain_mismatch: Your identity provider signed you in with an address outside your organisation's domains.
error.sso_link_refused: An account with this email already exists and cannot be signed in to through your identity provider. Ask an administrator.
error.sso_no_account: There is no account for you here yet. Ask an administrator to create one.
error.sso_required: Your organisation signs you in through {name}.
error.no_sso_connection: There is no single sign-on for that address. Sign in with your password instead.
error.password_not_offered: This sign-in does not use a password. Continue with one of the accounts below.
error.email_not_verified: Confirm your email address first: we have just sent you a link. Open it, then sign in again.
error.verification_invalid: This confirmation link has expired or has already been used. Sign in to get a new one.
error.social_not_offered: This sign-in does not offer other accounts. Sign in with your email address instead.
error.code_invalid: That code is not the one we sent. Check the message and try again.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. Sign in again to get a new one.
error.code_attempts_used: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again to get a new one.
error.code_too_soon: Wait a moment before asking for another code.
error.sign_in_closed: Sign-ins are closed right now. Try again later, or ask whoever runs this service.
error.email_change_not_offered: Your email cannot be changed here.
error.browser_session_required: Answer this in your own browser: an application cannot accept terms or allow itself on your behalf.
error.second_factor_invalid: That is not right. Try the newest code from your app, a recovery code, or your passkey again.
error.second_factor_expired: This sign-in has timed out. Sign in again.
error.two_step_not_offered: Two-step verification is not offered here.
error.second_factor_required: This application asks for two-step verification. Sign in again to set it up.
error.authenticator_exists: You already have an authenticator app. Remove it first to set up another.
error.passkey_limit: You have as many passkeys as an account may have. Remove one to add another.
error.passkey_refused: That passkey could not be added. Try again, or use another device.
error.passkey_sign_in_failed: Your passkey didn’t sign you in. Try again, or sign in another way.
error.device_code_invalid: That code doesn’t match a device waiting to sign in. Check it and try again, or start again on the device.
error.device_refused: Your account can’t use this application, so the device was not signed in.
error.sign_in_again: For your security, sign in again before changing how you sign in.
error.account_token_refused: This access token is not accepted by the account API: it has expired, is for another API, or its user can no longer sign in.
error.account_scope_missing: This access token needs the {scope} scope.
